description: This file defines the class 'soapclient2' which is a higher-level PHP class for simplified usage of SOAP web services. It includes methods for making SOAP calls, handling responses, managing headers, proxies, cookies, and WSDL operations.

classes.name: soapclient2
classes.description: A PHP class providing an easy and high-level interface for SOAP web service client operations, including method invocation, response parsing, and configuration management.

methods.name: soapclient2
methods.description: Constructor initializing the SOAP client with endpoint, WSDL flag, proxy settings, timeouts, and setting up WSDL parsing if applicable.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Performs a SOAP call to the specified operation with given parameters, handling serialization, request sending, and response parsing.

methods.name: getOperationData
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a specified operation from WSDL.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Handles the actual transmission of the SOAP message over HTTP or HTTPS.

methods.name: parseResponse
methods.description: Processes the SOAP response, extracting headers and returned data, handling encoding.

methods.name: setEndpoint
methods.description: Overrides the WSDL-defined or default endpoint URL.

methods.name: setHeaders
methods.description: Sets SOAP headers for subsequent requests.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Retrieves the response headers from the last SOAP reply.

methods.name: setHTTPProxy
methods.description: Configures proxy settings for HTTP/HTTPS transport.

methods.name: setCredentials
methods.description: Sets authentication credentials for the SOAP connection.

methods.name: useHTTPPersistentConnection
methods.description: Enables persistent HTTP connections for efficiency.

methods.name: getProxy
methods.description: Dynamically creates and returns a proxy class for WSDL operations.
